title: Factorization of the signed external Verdier contraction
statement:
Use the global finite-field and finite coefficient conventions of [def-trf-coefficient-conventions], so $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, and $A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ with $n\ge1$. Work with the geometric derived operations on $D^b_{ctf}(-,A)$, using the specified constructible exceptional adjunctions of [def-trf-admissibility]. All tensor products and pullbacks below are derived, with the signed symmetry of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom].

Let $X$ be a separated finite-type $k$-scheme, $a_X:X\to s$ its structure map, $Z=X\times_sX$ with projections $p_1,p_2$, and $\tau:Z\to Z$ the factor exchange. Let $K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$, $\omega=\omega_{X,A}$, $D=D_XK$, and $\operatorname{ev}:D\otimes K\to\omega$ be the dualizing data of [def-trf-dualizing-complex]. Set $P=Lp_1^*K\otimes Lp_2^*D$ and $Q=Lp_1^*D\otimes Lp_2^*K$. Write $s_P:R\tau_*P\xrightarrow{\sim}Q$ for the signed tensor swap. Identify $L\tau^*R\tau_*P=P$.

Define $\gamma:P\otimes Q\to\omega_{Z,A}$ by the permutation $(K_1,D_2,D_1,K_2)\mapsto(D_1,K_1,D_2,K_2)$ with its Koszul sign, followed by the two pullbacks of $\operatorname{ev}$ and the exceptional product map $\alpha_{a_X,a_X}:\omega\boxtimes\omega\to\omega_{Z,A}$ of [def-sf-kv-maps](ii). This is the contraction in [def-trf-supported-pairing], without a choice of supported classes. Let $\kappa:P\to R\mathcal Hom_A(Lp_2^*K,Rp_1^!K)$ be the map of [def-sf-kv-maps](iv), and $\kappa^T:P\otimes Lp_2^*K\to Rp_1^!K$ its tensor–Hom transpose. Let $\varpi:Lp_1^*D\otimes Rp_1^!K\to Rp_1^!\omega$ be the $Rp_{1!}\dashv Rp_1^!$ adjunct of
$$
Rp_{1!}(Lp_1^*D\otimes Rp_1^!K)\xrightarrow{\operatorname{PF}^{-1}}D\otimes Rp_{1!}Rp_1^!K\xrightarrow{1\otimes\varepsilon_{p_1}}D\otimes K\xrightarrow{\operatorname{ev}}\omega.
$$
Use the composition identification $Rp_1^!\omega\cong\omega_{Z,A}$ of [thm-trf-dualizing-complex-composition] and the factor-exchange identification $L\tau^*\omega_{Z,A}\cong\omega_{Z,A}$. With $r:L\tau^*P\otimes P\to Lp_1^*D\otimes(P\otimes Lp_2^*K)$ the signed permutation $(K_2,D_1,K_1,D_2)\mapsto(D_1,K_1,D_2,K_2)$, the following equality holds:
$$
L\tau^*\gamma\circ(1\otimes L\tau^*s_P)=\varpi\circ(1_{Lp_1^*D}\otimes\kappa^T)\circ r.
$$
All arrows use the specified geometric exceptional product, projection formula and adjunction maps; the equality includes their Koszul signs.

proof.text: Expand the left side using the definitions of the contraction in [def-trf-supported-pairing], the signed swap s_P, and the monoidal pullback along the factor exchange. The pullback of gamma contracts the four factors in the order (K_2,D_1,K_1,D_2) by first applying the signed permutation r to (D_1,K_1,D_2,K_2), then applying the two evaluations D_1 tensor K_1 to omega and D_2 tensor K_2 to omega, and finally applying the exceptional product map alpha_{a_X,a_X}: omega boxtimes omega -> omega_Z. The comparison L tau^* omega_Z with omega_Z is the one specified in the statement. Thus the left side is the canonical two-evaluation composite with the permutation r, including precisely its Koszul sign. The exchange of the two output dualizing factors agrees with factor exchange of the exceptional product: expand its defining counit transpose in [def-sf-kv-maps](ii) and use the exchange and signed tensor coherence of [prop-functor-package].

source.place: Step 3(c): definition of gamma^tau and the signed permutation r

proof.text: Specialize the evaluation formula for the Kunneth--Verdier map [lem-trf-kv-evaluation-formula] to M=N=K, Y=X, and the product X times_s X. It says that the tensor--Hom transpose of kappa is the composite which reassociates P tensor Lp_2^*K, applies 1 tensor Lp_2^*ev, and then applies the exceptional Kunneth map alpha_{id_X,a_X}: K boxtimes omega -> Rp_1^!K. This is exactly kappa^T with the signed tensor constraints of [def-sf-kv-maps], so no unrecorded sign or choice of inverse is introduced.

Write $a=a_X$, $p=p_1$, $H=D\otimes K$, $h=\operatorname{ev}:H\to\omega$, and $t=\varepsilon_a\circ Ra_!(h):Ra_!H\to A_s$. After the permutation $r$, the common source is $H\boxtimes H$, with the second evaluation still to be applied. Compare global exceptional adjuncts under $Ra_{Z!}\dashv Ra_Z^!$, using $a_Z=ap$ and the specified composition identification of [thm-trf-dualizing-complex-composition] and [def-trf-admissibility]. The counit formula [lem-trf-exceptional-kunneth-counit] with $f_1=f_2=a$, $L_1=L_2=A_s$, and precomposition $h\boxtimes h$ identifies the adjunct of the double-evaluation contraction with $Ra_{Z!}(H\boxtimes H)\xrightarrow{\mathrm{Ku}_{!,a,a}}Ra_!H\otimes Ra_!H\xrightarrow{t\otimes t}A_s$.

For the other side, use the same counit formula with $f_1=\operatorname{id}_X$, $f_2=a$, $L_1=K$, $L_2=A_s$, and precompose by $1_K\boxtimes h$. Together with Step 2 this says that the $p$-adjunct of the second-factor evaluation followed by $\alpha_{\operatorname{id},a}$ is $Rp_!(K\boxtimes H)\xrightarrow{\mathrm{Ku}_{!,\operatorname{id},a}}K\otimes La^*Ra_!H\xrightarrow{1_K\otimes La^*t}K$. Tensoring on the left by $Lp^*D$ and taking the adjunct defining $\varpi$ gives, by naturality of the projection formula, $Rp_!(H\boxtimes H)\xrightarrow{\mathrm{Ku}_{!,\operatorname{id},a}}H\otimes La^*Ra_!H\xrightarrow{1_H\otimes La^*t}H\xrightarrow h\omega$. Here compatibility with the left tensor factor is exactly projection coherence: expand $\mathrm{Ku}_!$ by [def-sf-kv-maps](i) into exchange and projection maps and use their tensor and exchange coherence in [prop-functor-package]. Applying $Ra_!$ and then $\varepsilon_a$ makes this the global adjunct. Compact-support composition and projection coherence, [prop-functor-package](3), (5) and its final clause, identify $Ra_!\mathrm{Ku}_{!,\operatorname{id},a}$ followed by the projection comparison with $\mathrm{Ku}_{!,a,a}$. Naturality of that projection comparison with respect to $t:Ra_!H\to A_s$ therefore identifies the global adjunct with the same $(t\otimes t)\circ\mathrm{Ku}_{!,a,a}$ displayed above. This is a comparison under the global adjunction, not an identification of the $a_Z$-adjunct with a $p_1$-adjunct. Injectivity of the global adjunction bijection proves the required equality after $r$. All inputs are in the finite-Tor constructible domains by [def-sf-kv-maps] and [prop-functor-package].

Combining Steps 1--3 gives Ltau^*gamma composed with (1 tensor Ltau^*s_P) equal to varpi composed with (1 tensor kappa^T) composed with r. All reassociations and exchanges are the canonical coherent constraints of the specified derived tensor and pullback operations; [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] supplies their signed symmetry, and [prop-functor-package] supplies compatibility of the projection, composition and exchange maps. Therefore the equality includes exactly the Koszul signs of the displayed permutations and holds in the prescribed geometric exceptional-adjunction data.
